title: command.staged@2
description: A destructive command had what it reaches staged as a copy-on-write copy before it ran: the folders of one whose reach can't be worked out, or each file of the tracked edits or stash entries it discards, with its digest. The run can be undone from the copy (deep undo staged:<id>) until the copy is let go.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

call.description: The tool call it was staged for, by the agent's tool_use_id: the call its tool.before carries.

command.description: The command, as the agent sent it.

folders.description: The absolute folders staged, in the order the copy holds them.

path.description: Where the file goes back to, absolute.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of its bytes when it was copied.

files.description: For a command that discards uncommitted edits (#1294): each file copied, in the order the copy holds them.

until.description: When the copy is let go, in ms on the hub's clock: the event's ts plus staging.keep.
